idea-plugin.name: Claude Todos
idea-plugin.description:
Live observability for your Claude Code agents: agent tree, per-task progress, tokens/context/cache and a 7-day usage dashboard — read from the transcripts Claude Code already writes. Companion of the Claude Todos VS Code extension.

实时观测你的 Claude Code 智能体：智能体树、每个任务的进度、令牌/上下文/缓存， 以及 7 天用量面板 —— 全部从 Claude Code 已经写入的对话记录中读取。 Claude Todos VS Code 扩展的配套插件。
